skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts and classifications of natural resources, their roles, and key issues in natural resource economics.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Supply and demand for natural resources
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze the supply and demand dynamics of natural resources including willingness-to-pay, discounting, opportunity costs, cost curves, social costs, and present value of costs.
Evaluate static and dynamic efficiency, social efficiency, and intergenerational equity in the context of natural resource management.
Examine market and social efficiency in the context of natural resource economics.
Understand the objectives, types, and implementation of public policies related to natural resources.
Apply principles of natural resource analysis to specific scenarios.
Conduct valuation of natural resources including use values and non-use values.
Understand the concepts, classification, geological factors, and economic aspects of mineral resource extraction.
Identify and analyze problems related to natural resource allocation, exploitation, and utilization.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Application of market tools and public policies
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply market tools and public policies to address natural resource issues.
Demonstrate responsibility when working independently and within a group.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate and defend personal viewpoints based on objective and scientific approaches.
Show social responsibility and professional ethics in making judgments and evaluations about professional issues.
